name: save-boot-30d-materia-list-end
description: #255 (measurement): what Down does at the list's last slot. Load harness/saves/disc1-md1stin-materia-slots.json (Cloud alone with weapon 4 and armor 8, author-chosen numbers whose slot counts, 8 and at least 1, are a source claim; materia slots empty; materia 49 in inventory slots 2, 7, 13 and 199 only, AP = slot), open the field menu, plan the main-menu cursor 0 to 2 (semantic/menu-panel.js), Circle every 60 frames until menu_ovl reads 3 (ovl_wait), 120 frames; the slot cursor reads row 0, column 0. Circle (opens the list for the slot under the cursor, #241) and 60 frames; the list row and offset read 0 (#244). Then w_last: materiaListPlan({"row":0,"offset":0}, 199), 199 Downs, each a 4-frame press, a wait of at most 30 frames for the cursor that should move (the row, or the offset on a scroll) and a one-frame check of the other, 8 frames between presses; it should end on row 9, offset 190. Then one more Down (4 frames) and 30 frames, nothing checked. Reports the list row and offset at the end: row 9, offset 190 if Down stops at slot 199; row 0, offset 0 if it wraps to slot 0. Checks: still on overlay 3 in the menu, materia untouched, a rerun matches. Only frame counts, 1/0, cursor indices and author-chosen words leave.
